title: Starbucks Orange Mango Tumbler 2022 Ombre Jeweled Studded Venti Tumbler Cold Cup
descriptionText:
No lid, no straw.

This Starbucks Tumbler is a must-have for any coffee and tea lover! The vibrant orange color and jeweled studded design make it a unique addition to your collection. This Venti Cold Cup is perfect for enjoying your favorite iced coffee or tea on-the-go.

Created in 2022, this original Starbucks Tumbler is a rare find and a great investment for any collector. The ombre design and studded accents add a touch of elegance to your everyday beverage. Made in China and compliant with California Prop 65 Warning, this tumbler is perfect for anyone who loves Starbucks and wants to add a unique piece to their collection.
